job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled Full Stack .NET Developer to join the GEDU IT Engineering Team in Noida, where you will build innovative software solutions, collaborate with cross-functional Agile teams, influence product strategy, and deliver exceptional user experiences while driving business impact.

What We Expect from You

Participate in the design, development, customization, troubleshooting, and maintenance of software applications within a Low-Code/No-Code platform ecosystem.
Develop and maintain RESTful APIs, OData services, and microservices-based solutions using Microsoft .NET technologies.
Develop dynamic and responsive user interfaces using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern frontend frameworks.
Build reusable UI components, design systems, JSON-driven forms, and configurable user experiences based on metadata and business rules.
Implement authentication, authorization, and security controls using JWT, OAuth 2.0, and Azure Active Directory.
Design and optimize database schemas, stored procedures, indexing strategies, and data access layers for high-volume enterprise applications.
Build asynchronous processing solutions using Azure Service Bus Topics & Subscriptions and event-driven architectures.
Utilize Azure Blob Storage, Azure Functions, Azure Key Vault, Azure Application Insights for enterprise application development and monitoring.
Collaborate with team members and business stakeholders to deliver end-to-end solutions.
Participate in architecture reviews, technical design discussions, sprint planning, code reviews, and production support activities.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, integration, performance, and production issues.
Work independently in a fast-paced environment requiring multitasking, ownership, and efficient time management.

What You Bring

5 -7 years of experience in Full Stack .NET Development.
Strong backend development experience with ASP.NET Core Web API, .NET Core/.NET 6/7/8, C#, and RESTful API design and development. 
Proven frontend development expertise using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3 to build responsive, user-centric web applications.
Experience with Object-Oriented Programming (OOPS), SOLID Principles, Design Patterns, Design Principles, and N-Tier Architecture.
Strong experience in Microservices Architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, and Distributed Systems Design.
Experience with Entity Framework Core, LINQ, Lambda Expressions, and ORM frameworks.
Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL.
Experience working with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Registry (ACR), Azure Blob Storage, Azure Service Bus Topics & Subscriptions, Azure Functions, Azure Key Vault, Azure Application Insights.
Prior experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Prior experience working in product-based organizations, preferably in Ed-Tech/E-Learning domains.
Basic knowledge of integrating applications with Single Sign-On (SSO), Active Directory.
Any relevant Full Stack, Microsoft, Azure, React, or .NET certification will be an added advantage.
Experience with Azure DevOps, YAML Pipelines, Azure Repos, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Docker-based deployments.
